title: Define ambient color orchestration and proportional radius system
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Multiple token families (palette, elevation, radius) drifted independently over time. Tables, charts and dense control surfaces show inconsistent contrast and mismatched corner radii across breakpoints. Goal: introduce a small, opinionated ambient color orchestration layer (a set of ambient tint/overlay tokens that harmonize across elevation) and a proportional radius system that scales radii based on density tokens. This work reduces token duplication, improves perceived depth consistency for charts/tables, and makes compact/comfortable mode transitions predictable for engineers and product teams. Deliverables: token spec, Figma kit, migration guide for components (buttons, table rows, chart cards), PRs for token library and component updates, automated visual regression sweeps for impacted components.
acceptance_criteria:
- Ambient color tokens defined: ambient-0..ambient-5 with usage guidance and WCAG contrast target examples.
- Proportional radius rules specified: radius.scale (0..4) mapped to density anchors (compact, default, spacious) and examples for table rows, cards, buttons.
- Shadow / elevation recipes updated to reference ambient tokens so color of penumbra and halo are consistent across themes.
- Figma kit updated and published (token page + sample components).
- Migration guide with component-by-component checklist and explicit fallback mapping for legacy tokens.
- Cross-team signoff from Eng runtime, PM (data-grid), and Accessibility review.
- Two component PRs merged covering table rows and chart cards, plus one token library bump.
- Automated Percy/Galley visual run shows <=3 unexpected diffs flagged and triaged.
design_notes:
Context: Current neutral ramps were tailored separately for surfaces and shadows, causing subtle hue shifts when stacking elevation layers on charts. Approach: introduce a single ambient layer that sits above neutral base and below accent ramps; ambient tokens are expressed as HSL variable tokens with neutralized chroma and preserved lightness deltas for dark mode.
Token naming: ambient.{0..5} (semantic), radius.{scale-0..4} (semantic), density.{compact|default|spacious} anchors.
Implementation guidance: CSS variables exported from token build (tokens.css), JS token shim for runtime theme switching, Figma tokens folder (tokens/ambient & tokens/radius).
Typography: keep existing scale but add density-aware type-size tokens (type.small-compact, type.small-default) to pair with radius changes for legibility in compact mode.
Shadows: replace hard-coded rgba values with composed color tokens: shadow-penumbra (uses ambient.x) and shadow-ambient-halo. This preserves perceived warmth/coolness across themes.
Accessibility: provide contrast recipes for foreground-on-surface at each elevation step (example table row text on elevated card must meet AA normal text at compact density).
Migration: automated codemod mapping old tokens neutral-1->ambient-1, corner-md->radius.scale-2, etc. Include a dry-run script and fallbacks for older SDK versions.
decisions:
- Use ambient token family instead of adding more neutral variants.
- Radii are proportional to density anchors (not fixed px across breakpoints).
- Shadows will reference ambient colors, not separate shadow-only ramps.
- Keep one source of truth: token library is canonical; components must not hardcode color/shadow values.
- Accessibility thresholds prioritized for tables and charts where text density is highest.
